**Connection check for household-manager-production.up.railway.app (read-only)**

| # | Connection | Status | Evidence | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | App up | OK | `/` returns 307 to `/signin`. `/signin` returns 200. I saw no 5xx. | None. |
| 2 | Google sign-in | OK | `/api/auth/providers` lists google, with callback `…/api/auth/callback/google`. A CSRF-correct POST to `/api/auth/signin/google` returns 302 to accounts.google.com with `redirect_uri` equal to that callback URL. | None. A bare GET of `/api/auth/signin/google` redirects to `/signin?error=Configuration`. That is normal Auth.js behaviour for a GET, not a fault. |
| 3 | Database | Not checked | Pages that need the DB sit behind sign-in. I had no session and no run logs. | Pavel: sign in and open a finance page, or share the Railway logs. Look for "relation does not exist", which means migration 0004 (card catalog) is not applied. |
| 4 | Cron routes | OK (routes only) | `/api/cron/simplefin-sync`, `/monthly-advisor` and `/card-catalog` each answer 401 without credentials, so the routes are live. | None for the routes. I could not see whether the Railway cron service is running hourly. Pavel: check in Railway that it has `APP_URL` and `CRON_SECRET` and the start command from `scripts/cron.mjs`. |
| 5 | SimpleFIN | Partly checked | bridge.simplefin.org answers (302). `SIMPLEFIN_ACCESS_URL` is optional in `env.ts` and I can't see its value. | Pavel: confirm the variable is set in Railway and that the last-sync time in the app is under 12 hours old. |
| 6 | AI provider | Not checked | `GEMINI_API_KEY` and `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` are both optional and not visible to me. I had no advisor run logs. | Pavel: confirm the key for the selected provider is set. Check the last monthly-advisor run for auth errors. |
| 7 | Trips data hosts | Degraded (likely my network) | The geocoding host (`geocoding-api.open-meteo.com`) returns 200. Wikipedia returns 301, which is a normal redirect. Overpass returns 406 to a bare probe, so the host is up. `api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast` timed out on connect after 15 seconds. | Retry later and check open-meteo's status page. A timeout from this sandbox doesn't prove the production server is affected. If trip weather fails in the app, that is the cause. |
| 8 | Outbound allowlist | OK | Every host in the code's `fetch` calls is in `hosts.ts`: open-meteo (both hosts), Wikipedia and Overpass. The bank and card-issuer domains only appear as seed data in `finance/rewards/catalog/seed.ts`, not as fetch targets. I did not trace every call path that uses the allowlist wrapper. | None. |

**Nothing is confirmed broken.** The app, Google OAuth and the cron routes all work. The three unverified items need you to look inside Railway or sign in (rows 3, 5 and 6). The only live anomaly is the open-meteo forecast timeout in row 7.
